# 📦 Product Inventory API

**Lab Task 04 — Single Entity CRUD with TypeORM & PostgreSQL**

![NestJS](https://img.shields.io/badge/NestJS-E0234E?style=for-the-badge&logo=nestjs&logoColor=white)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-3178C6?style=for-the-badge&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)
![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-4169E1?style=for-the-badge&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)
![TypeORM](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeORM-FE0803?style=for-the-badge&logo=typeorm&logoColor=white)

*Entity · Repository · CRUD Operations · DTO Validation · Query & Filter*

</div>

<hr />
<h2>📖 About</h2>
<p>A Product Inventory REST API for an e-commerce platform, built with <strong>NestJS</strong>, <strong>TypeORM</strong> and <strong>PostgreSQL</strong>.
It manages a single <code>Products</code> entity and supports:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete)</li>
<li>Full replace (<code>PUT</code>) and partial update (<code>PATCH</code>)</li>
<li>Input validation using DTOs and <code>class-validator</code></li>
<li>Filtering by category and searching by name</li>
<li>Toggling a product's active / inactive status</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>All database operations go through TypeORM repositories. No raw SQL is used.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr />
<h2>🛠️ Tech Stack</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Technology</th>
<th>Purpose</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>NestJS</td>
<td>Backend framework</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>TypeORM + <code>@nestjs/typeorm</code></td>
<td>ORM and repository pattern</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>PostgreSQL + <code>pg</code></td>
<td>Database and driver</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>class-validator / class-transformer</td>
<td>DTO validation and type transformation</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>@nestjs/mapped-types</td>
<td><code>PartialType</code> for the PATCH DTO</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr />
<h2>🗂️ Project Structure</h2>
<pre><code>product-inventory-api/
├── src/
│   ├── products/
│   │   ├── Entities/
│   │   │   └── products.entity.ts
│   │   ├── dto/
│   │   │   ├── create-product.dto.ts
│   │   │   ├── update-product.dto.ts            # PUT   (extends CreateProductDto)
│   │   │   └── partial-update-product.dto.ts    # PATCH (PartialType)
│   │   ├── products.controller.ts
│   │   ├── products.module.ts
│   │   └── products.service.ts
│   ├── app.module.ts
│   └── main.ts
├── Screensort/            # Postman test screenshots
├── .gitignore
└── package.json
</code></pre>
<p>Architecture flow: <strong>Module → Controller → Service → Entity → DTO</strong></p>
<hr />
<h2>🗄️ Product Entity</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>id</code></td>
<td>number</td>
<td>Auto-increment primary key</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>name</code></td>
<td>string</td>
<td>Product name</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>description</code></td>
<td>string (nullable)</td>
<td>Optional description</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>price</code></td>
<td>decimal(10,2)</td>
<td>Price with 2 decimal places</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>stock</code></td>
<td>number (default <code>0</code>)</td>
<td>Available stock quantity</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>category</code></td>
<td>string</td>
<td>Product category, e.g. Electronics</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>isActive</code></td>
<td>boolean (default <code>true</code>)</td>
<td>Whether the product is active</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>createdAt</code></td>
<td>Date</td>
<td>Set automatically on create</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>updatedAt</code></td>
<td>Date</td>
<td>Set automatically on update</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr />
<h2>🚀 Getting Started</h2>
<h3>1. Clone and install</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">git clone &lt;your-repository-url&gt;
cd product-inventory-api
npm install
</code></pre>
<h3>2. Create the database</h3>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE DATABASE product_inventory_db;
</code></pre>
<h3>3. Configure the connection</h3>
<p>Open <code>src/app.module.ts</code> and set your PostgreSQL username and password:</p>
<pre><code class="language-ts">TypeOrmModule.forRoot({
  type: 'postgres',
  host: 'localhost',
  port: 5432,
  username: 'postgres',
  password: 'your_password',
  database: 'product_inventory_db',
  autoLoadEntities: true,
  synchronize: true,
}),
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <code>synchronize: true</code> is for development only. The <code>products</code> table is created automatically on the first run.</p>
</blockquote>
<h3>4. Run the app</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">npm run start:dev
</code></pre>
<p>The API runs at <strong>http://localhost:3000</strong></p>
<hr />
<h2>🔗 API Endpoints</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Method</th>
<th>Route</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>POST</code></td>
<td><code>/products</code></td>
<td>Create a new product</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>GET</code></td>
<td><code>/products</code></td>
<td>Get all products (newest first)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>GET</code></td>
<td><code>/products/search?keyword=</code></td>
<td>Search products by name</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>GET</code></td>
<td><code>/products/category/:cat</code></td>
<td>Get all products in a category</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>GET</code></td>
<td><code>/products/:id</code></td>
<td>Get one product by id</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>PATCH</code></td>
<td><code>/products/:id</code></td>
<td>Partial update</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>PUT</code></td>
<td><code>/products/:id</code></td>
<td>Full replace (all required fields needed)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>PATCH</code></td>
<td><code>/products/:id/toggle</code></td>
<td>Toggle active / inactive</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>DELETE</code></td>
<td><code>/products/:id</code></td>
<td>Delete a product</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>Validation rules (<code>CreateProductDto</code>)</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Field</th>
<th>Required</th>
<th>Rules</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>name</code></td>
<td>✅</td>
<td>string, not empty</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>description</code></td>
<td>❌</td>
<td>string</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>price</code></td>
<td>✅</td>
<td>number, positive</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>stock</code></td>
<td>❌</td>
<td>integer, min 0</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>category</code></td>
<td>✅</td>
<td>string, not empty</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>isActive</code></td>
<td>❌</td>
<td>boolean</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Global <code>ValidationPipe</code> options: <code>whitelist</code>, <code>forbidNonWhitelisted</code>, <code>transform</code>.</p>

<h2>✅ Architecture Rules Followed</h2>
<ul>
<li>Entity uses <code>@Entity()</code>, <code>@PrimaryGeneratedColumn()</code> and <code>@Column()</code></li>
<li><code>createdAt</code> / <code>updatedAt</code> are managed by <code>@CreateDateColumn()</code> / <code>@UpdateDateColumn()</code></li>
<li>Repository injected with <code>@InjectRepository(Products)</code></li>
<li>All database calls are in the Service, none in the Controller</li>
<li><code>NotFoundException</code> is thrown for missing records</li>
<li><code>PartialType</code> is used for the PATCH DTO</li>
<li><code>ParseIntPipe</code> is used with every <code>@Param('id')</code></li>
<li>Specific routes (<code>search</code>, <code>category/:cat</code>) are defined before <code>:id</code></li>
<li><code>@Controller('products')</code> is used for all routes</li>
</ul>
<hr />
<h2>📝 Notes</h2>
<ul>
<li><code>price</code> is a PostgreSQL <code>decimal</code>, so it is returned as a string (e.g. <code>"999.99"</code>) when read back from the database.</li>
<li><code>synchronize: true</code> is for development only and must not be used in production.</li>
</ul>
